tools.name: resolve_aid
tools.description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Resolve one Agentic ID (AID), written "Agentic ID (AID) AI-XXXXXX", to the free hotel card: name, city, country, group/brand, official website, Sabre/Amadeus/Galileo/Worldspan codes and awards. Exact match only: an unknown AID returns AID_N

tools.name: find_hotel
tools.description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Search SVAMI hotels by name, city or GDS code (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Apollo, Worldspan) and get candidate Agentic IDs. tools.description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Activate a single-use SVAMI gift code (e.g. SV-GIFT-XXXX-XXXX) for an email address and optional organization name. Atomically activates the subscription plan and mints a live API key returned ONCE. Store the returned api_key in a server-si

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "redeem_gift_code" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
